title: PowerPoint on the web: reference webpages when creating a presentation with Copilot Agent Mode
summary: Hold: the briefing omits two important qualifications about web search. Very short prompts can be sent to Bing in full, and an existing optional-connected-experiences policy can disable web search even when its dedicated policy is unconfigured. It also reports rollout mechanics as unpublished although the release notes describe gradual deployment.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Copilot web search sends generated search queries to the Bing search service.
claims.quote: Based on these terms, Copilot generates a search query that it sends to the Bing search service asking for more information.

claims.claim: Copilot sends a generated search query, not the whole prompt, to Bing.
claims.quote: The following information isn't included in the generated search query sent to the Bing search service: ... The user's entire prompt, unless the prompt is very short (for example, "local weather")
claims.fix: Replace 'not the whole prompt' with 'not the whole prompt unless the prompt is very short (for example, "local weather")', as stated at https://learn.microsoft.com/copilot/plan/manage-public-web-access.

claims.claim: Copilot also sends the user's client IP address to Bing.
claims.quote: When Copilot sends a web search request to the Bing search service, it also sends the user's client IP address, which Bing uses to help localize results, such as nearby weather and events.

claims.claim: The generated query may use data within a Microsoft 365 document when a prompt is entered inside a Microsoft 365 app.
claims.quote: However, it may also be informed by data within a Microsoft 365 document ... When a user enters a prompt into Copilot inside a Microsoft 365 application
